title: "Publications"

listing:
  - id: papers
    contents:

    template: ../_ejs/publication-card.ejs
    sort: "date desc"
    fields: [title, image, date, paper-authors, pub-date, venue, snippet]
  - id: news
    contents:
      - title: "Research uses AI-based system to predict meat quality from cellphone photos"
        path: "https://portal.fgv.br/en/noticias/research-uses-ai-based-system-predict-meat-quality-cellphone-photos"
        date: 2025-07-16
        news-source: "FGV"
        news-date: "July 16, 2025"
        image: "images/news-carne.png"
        summary: "Study paves the way for developing applications that help consumers identify, through images, softer and juicier
        cuts."
      - title: "Study monitors deforestation and identifies plant species using artificial intelligence"
        path: "https://portal.fgv.br/en/node/21767"
        date: 2025-03-20
        news-source: "FGV (in Portuguese)"
        news-date: "March 20, 2025"
        image: "images/news-desmatamento.jpg"
        summary: "The LLP-Co method learns visual patterns and clusters large data volumes automatically, applied to identifying 
        deforested areas and features of plant biodiversity in the Amazon rainforest."
      - title: "Researchers create algorithm for crop classification using satellite images"
        path: "https://portal.fgv.br/en/news/researchers-create-algorithm-crop-classification-using-satellite-images"
        date: 2024-10-08
        news-source: "FGV"
        news-date: "October 8, 2024"
        image: "images/news-agricultura.jpg"

    template: ../_ejs/news-card.ejs
